title: next-up-hb result
description: One top pick, a few alternates, and the health footer's facts. The result shape of the /next-up-hb runner op (#116) -- versioned beside its SKILL.md (#41 decision 4). No $schema key: the CLI's --json-schema rejects the draft-2020-12 ref outright.

pick.description: The one top pick, or null when the candidate list came back empty -- never an invented pick.

seq.description: The HB-42 display handle, when the item carries one.

why.description: One line, built from the candidate's own reason codes -- the actual decisive rule, never a step index and never a restatement of the six steps.

alternates.description: 3-5 runners-up, one line each. Never the full list.

note.description: The one label or date that matters for this alternate.

health.description: The footer's facts, carried through from the ranker's own health block.

blocked_upstream.description: How many otherwise-qualifying items were held back by a live blocker.

agent_doable.description: How many live, unshut items carry #10's agent axis -- what could be handed off. Carried through from the ranker's health block, never recounted.

fog_exhausted.description: Projects whose actions are all shut while a fog question still names a real unknown -- the reading, already made, not the raw rows.

questions.description: The open fog questions that were judged to name real unknowns, verbatim.
